answer: Plant the agent economy as an orchard: each established identity may sponsor only a few saplings, and part of every sapling's earnings is escrowed to its sponsor. A light zephyr audit samples saplings at random; a proven fake prunes the whole branch — sapling and sponsor stakes are burned and sponsorship rights revoked. Honest sponsors climb to the summit, where more sponsorship slots are earned only after many clean audits. A Sybil farmer must buy or bribe many real sponsors and still risks losing every branch at once, so scaling fakes costs more than the fakes can ever earn.
